# Copilot Repository Instructions

Read `README.md` first before proposing plans or making code changes.

Use `README.md` as the product source of truth for:

- Product vision and scope
- Required stack: Next.js + TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, Supabase, Vercel
- Multimodal PDF handling requirements (text, images, charts, tables)
- Anti-hallucination controls (grounded answers, citations, confidence thresholds)
- Professional engineering standards (security, reliability, testing, governance)

If a request conflicts with `README.md`, ask for clarification and note the conflict.
